JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Armanda, Augustina, Francesco, Jenise, Lennie, Zelda

I’ll likely claim that unless someone else already taking it; prefer non-duplicate. Also feasible but higher cost: ISSUE-0001::review (effort2, cost2.52) or docs/test (cost3.52). Let’s coordinate to cover multiple tasks without duplicates.
If you need a frontend handoff: I suggest mapping others to ISSUE-0001::review/docs/test while I take ISSUE-0001::triage. Please respond with your intended picks to avoid conflicts.

Armanda (avail 8h, top skill ML). In planning, I intend to take a machine-learning related micro-task to leverage skill: considering ISSUE-0002::review/ test/ implement. However costs are high; to avoid conflicts, I’m leaning ISSUE-0002::review (lowest among ISSUE-0002). Please confirm if anyone already plans to take ISSUE-0002::*.

I will only claim one task. If ISSUE-0002::review is already assigned by another agent, I will switch to another low-effort feasible one (otherwise skip). Reply with your intended claim for ISSUE-0002::review.

Planning (Francesco): availability 10h, top skills ML/mobile. I can take ISSUE-0002::review (effort3.0, low priority) or ISSUE-0002::test (effort4.2, low). Given your note, Armanda seems to target ISSUE-0002::review; to avoid duplicate I propose I take ISSUE-0002::test instead (assuming unclaimed). Please confirm. Otherwise I will skip.
